text:
sam chen: Handoff (quick async) — what I did / blockers / today

sam chen: What I did: triaged the regen surge in eu-west1, rolled back canary for model-v2, restarted 3/5 kvcache pods to clear stale entries. Tuned autoscaler threshold for regen-proxy.

sam chen: Blockers: embeddings-store read latency spikes causing ~5–10% 5xx on /embed during peak. Replica lag on storage reads persists.

sam chen: Mitigations applied: temporarily throttled ingest pipeline, enabled fallback route to small-quant model for non-critical requests, and enabled request-level retry (2 attempts) for embed reads.

sam chen: Today: monitor error rate, follow up with storage team on replica lag ticket, prepare canary re-roll with more conservative concurrency. Will escalate if error rate doesn't drop by 16:30 PT.

oncall-bot: [ALERT] INC-2026-042 created — embeddings-store read errors above threshold (12% over 5m). Pager sent to eng-ml and eng-sre.

anya li: Thanks — quick Q: which k8s restart you used for kvcache? also can you paste the probe/healthcheck you added?

sam chen: used:```kubectl rollout restart deployment/kvcache --namespace=prod --timeout=5m```
Probe added (http):```/healthz?kvcache=ready -> 200 within 500ms, failing -> alert to oncall-bot```

mike ramos: FYI I'm running a small qps test against the fallback /embed path now, starting at 50rps for 5m, will ramp to 200 if stable. Ping me to pause.

jordan p: Left logs + heap/GC traces in ENG-2311. Noticed regen-proxy-5 CPU goes spiky ~1m before the 5xx bursts. Could be KV GC interaction with large batches.

sam chen: good call — I trimmed batch size on regen-proxy to 8 for canary. After throttles/error retries, error rate down to ~4% in last 3m, but still seeing intermittent 7m spikes.

anya li: If it doesn't stabilise, I can push ops/rollback-eviction patch (ops/rollback-eviction) — that'll revert the eviction change from last week.

sam chen: noted. If back to >8% by 16:30 PT I'll escalate and ask for rollback. For now I'll keep monitoring, coordinate with Mike on qps test, and update ENG-2311 with mitigation notes. :thumbsup:

mike ramos: I see a small uptick around 5139991300 in metrics — correlates with a kvcache restart. I'll hold the ramp until you say go.

jordan p: tagging storage lead @lee (in ticket) to take a look at replica lag patterns.

sam chen: thanks — handoff complete. If anything urgent, call me. root thread ts: 5139991234
